content.comment_body: If I choose a VFD that offers Modbus TCP functionality, it should be able to connect with a [product_name] controller from the 8th generation.
Are you asking a question or making a statement?

If your VFD supports the S7 protocol, it can work with the standard [product_name] 8 controller. However, I am uncertain if Modbus TCP would require the base unit to be [product_name] 8.2 [article_no].
No, [product_name] 8.1 also supports Modbus TCP/IP. Additionally, the current [product_name] 8.3 offers this as well.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are evaluating if a VFD using Modbus TCP can interact with [product_name] 8 controllers. There is some uncertainty about which versions or firmware revisions of [product_name] 8 enable Modbus TCP communication, causing confusion regarding compatibility and required hardware features. Users seek definitive information about supported protocols and the necessary hardware version for seamless communication between the VFD and [product_name] controllers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want straightforward and dependable compatibility between [product_name] 8 controllers and any VFD supporting Modbus TCP, with no complicated setup or additional hardware needed.
